# Battery Guardian - Complete Specifications & Feature Context

Battery Guardian is an advanced Android battery tracking and telemetry application engineered to surface hidden degradation drivers that stock operating systems do not report.

## Detailed Diagnostic Capabilities

### 1. Advanced Telemetry Analytics
- Effective Cycles: Measures precision electrochemical wear over standard arbitrary nominal cycle counts.
- Degradation Drivers: Tracks thermal spikes, stress voltage thresholds, and charging/discharging power surges.
- Penalty Factor Tracking: Computes excess wear values dynamically based on live usage habits.
- Lifespan Forecasting: Models historical degradation trends to project estimated battery end-of-life dates.

### 2. Performance & App Analysis
- Real-Time Charge Meter: Live milliampere (mA) draw details per active software process.
- Sleep Telemetry: Pinpoints background wake-locks and overnight drain events.

### 3. Privacy Commitments
- Zero data collection.
- Offline-first operational architecture.
- No third-party advertisements or bloatware modules.
